fact: In June 2026 a government review reported the computerised system for registering civil status events deployed in 30 main and 140 secondary centres, with 78 main centres networked, and on 22 October 2026 the Council of Ministers adopted a decree on online issuance of birth, marriage and death certificates and electronic archiving.
title: Le Burkina Faso se dote d'un cadre pour la délivrance en ligne des actes d'état civil
